ConfigFile is processed at its position; nested files are therefore ordered

case.main_value: normally case-sensitive unless that setting says otherwise

invalid_channels: non-assignment non-section line: fatal configuration-file error
unknown main key: error diagnostic and continuation
unknown section: warning, then an accumulated section is created
section-specific malformed data: delegated to its consumer
partitions: failure after an earlier valid setting

dm5.line_forms: Documented as assignment lines in an initial settings section followed by asterisk-led sections; blank and # lines are ignored; spaces are optional.
dm5.case: DM5 documentation says strings are case-insensitive, unlike DM6's main-value/section distinction.
dm5.loading_model: Global configuration, then optional personal configuration, then Date_Init overrides; the legacy path and file-name controls are separate config domains.
gaps: Exact DM5 parser acceptance, diagnostics, inline comments, and malformed-line behavior have not been probed.

production_forms: yearless date to which a year can be appended
holidays.semantics: A holiday occupies one civil day. Blank labels remain holidays. Multiple labels/dates and repeated definitions are permitted; definition order can change working-day-relative recurrence results.
holidays.dm5_difference: DM5 also documents date plus/minus delta forms and describes identical recurrence keys as a hash-era limitation; DM6 documents an ordered list and permits repeated recurrence definitions.

events.semantics: Timed Date/Recur forms default to one hour; date-only YMD/YM forms occupy the whole day. Events do not alter business-day calculations. Documentation says durations beyond one year are unsupported and not validated.
events.dm5_difference: DM5 documents date-without-time and recurrence-without-time separately, and additionally documents three-part date-or-recurrence plus two deltas. Exact compatibility must be observed.

precise_gaps: Config.pod does not enumerate a formal grammar for every value domain or every diagnostic channel.
The domain inventory has no reviewed runtime observation for its listed partitions.
DM5’s historical global/personal loading behavior is documented but not reconciled to a DM6 equivalent because DM6 uses ordered ConfigFile processing.
Holiday/event date, recurrence, and delta subgrammars are owned by their corresponding contract families; this record only identifies the section productions.
